name: Floot
summary: Connector that builds full-stack web and mobile apps from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor chats.
description: Floot plugs into Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor so users describe an app in chat and get a hosted full-stack app with database, auth, email and a live URL, including app-store publish flows. Differentiator is staying inside the chat/agent the user already pays for while Floot handles backend and hosting. Official pricing: Free $0 (100 build actions/day), Pro $25/month, Power $100/month.
features: Works inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
Hosted full-stack app with database, auth and email
Free plan with 100 build actions per day
